sharedConfigUrl.title: Shared configuration URL
sharedConfigUrl.description: HTTPS address of the shared bc-buddy.json. BC Buddy keeps it in sync daily and users cannot change or clear it.

webClientEnabled.title: Web client improvements
webClientEnabled.description: Turns the Web client improvements (and the keyboard shortcuts) on or off. Users cannot change it.

environmentsEnabled.title: Environment colours
environmentsEnabled.description: Turns environment colours (own and shared rules) on or off. Users cannot change it.

feedbackEnabled.title: Help & feedback
feedbackEnabled.description: Turns the Help & feedback report form in the side panel on or off. Users cannot change it.

feedbackEmail.title: Help & feedback email address
feedbackEmail.description: The one address reports are sent to. An invalid address is ignored.

feedbackPriorities.title: Help & feedback priorities
feedbackPriorities.description: The priorities the report form offers: 1 to 10 names of at most 40 characters, the same for every language unless feedbackTranslations translates them. An empty list hides the priority field, as it is without priorities.

feedbackDefaultPriority.title: Help & feedback default priority
feedbackDefaultPriority.description: The priority the form starts on. Must be one of the priorities, in any language; anything else means no default.

feedbackSubjectBug.title: Help & feedback subject for a problem
feedbackSubjectBug.description: Subject line of a problem report, at most 200 characters on one line. Placeholders: {prio} {company} {environment} {title}. The same for every language unless feedbackTranslations translates it.

feedbackSubjectIdea.title: Help & feedback subject for an idea
feedbackSubjectIdea.description: Subject line of an idea, at most 200 characters on one line. Placeholders: {prio} {company} {environment} {title}. The same for every language unless feedbackTranslations translates it.

feedbackUrgentText.title: Help & feedback message for urgent problems
feedbackUrgentText.description: Shown under the priority when someone picks the last priority in the list, at most 200 characters on one line. It does not go into the report. The same for every language unless feedbackTranslations translates it.

feedbackUrgentLink.title: Help & feedback link for urgent problems
feedbackUrgentLink.description: Optional link on that message: an https:// address (at most 500 characters) or tel: with a phone number (digits, spaces, + ( ) - . only).

feedbackTranslations.title: Help & feedback translations
feedbackTranslations.description: Texts per language, shown to users whose Business Central runs in that language (or, failing that, whose BC Buddy does). Languages without a block, and fields left out of a block, use the plain feedbackPriorities, feedbackSubjectBug, feedbackSubjectIdea and feedbackUrgentText.
